messages:
tara (Docs): quick heads-up: users reported the Console "cost by trace" guide shows blank trace ids after the tracing-hook migration. anyone seen this? :eyes:

emma (SRE): yes i noticed it on staging this morning. appears only for node snippets that use the new tracer-wrapper. trace headers not forwarded on outbound fetches.

rick (Platform): same - our dashboard join requires a consistent `x-rd-trace` or the new context forward. snippet in docs replaced our old example with the new lib but didn't include the forward call.

tara (Docs): ok can we decide on fallback guidance? i don't want to break customers still on older runtimes.

emma (SRE): proposal: show both examples side-by-side (legacy header + new trace.forward). short note: "pick based on runtime version".

dan (Docs): i can update the docs page and add a tiny migration table. will also include a code diff so it's copy/paste ready.

tara (Docs): great. sample text i'll add under "Node tracing" -> "Migration":

```text
If your runtime < 1.8: continue sending the legacy header `X-Trace-Id`.
If your runtime >= 1.8: call `tracer.forward(req)` in middleware to preserve trace context across proxies.
```

tara (Docs): code snippets i'll include (both):

```js
// legacy (older runtimes)
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  res.setHeader('X-Trace-Id', getTraceId())
  next()
})

// recommended (new tracer lib)
const tracer = require('@redwood/tracer')
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  tracer.forward(req) // attaches trace context for downstream fetches
  next()
})
```

emma (SRE): add an integration test pointer: infra-tests/tracing/propagation_check.js — it verifies that the ingestion pipeline receives `trace_id`. will open a tiny PR to reference it.

ci-bot: PR created: docs#755 "docs: node tracing migration examples + dashboard note" by dan (Docs)

rick (Platform): also update the Console sample dashboard id in the docs to `dash:v3/cost-trace-join` (old id `dash:v2/cost-join` no longer compatible).

tara (Docs): noted. dan, can you swap the template id and add a short callout in the dashboard samples section?

dan (Docs): yep. planning to include a before/after screenshot pair and a note about expected p50 shift when trace propagation is fixed.

katie (Support): can we have a one-line blurb for customer comms? some customers emailed support showing missing numbers in the sidebar widget.

tara (Docs): will draft: "Fix deployed: node tracing example updated to preserve trace context. If you see missing trace-linked costs, please confirm your runtime >=1.8 or use the legacy header. See migration guide: /docs/console/tracing-migration."

emma (SRE): staging verified after ci-bot merged docs#755 and infra-tests#162 — trace ids present in ingestion and dashboard joins line up.

ci-bot: deployment succeeded: staging build 2026-03-21T15:40:00Z (docs#755, infra-tests#162)

tara (Docs): merged to main and backported to v3 docs. leaving a note in CHANGES.md and will post the blurb to #customer-status shortly.

rick (Platform): leaving a follow-up ticket to audit python and go examples (they still use header-only patterns). linking to ticket: https://tickets.internal/TCK-482

emma (SRE): thanks all. thread closed unless follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
